newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Palm Springs USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
General Obligation Bonds, 1992 Election, Series E
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Education of the Palm Springs Unified School District, Riverside County,
California, intends to sell $10,000,000 principal amount of Palm Springs Unified School District General Obligation Bonds, 1992 Election, Series E. Bids will be received on

at 10:00 a.m., at the offices of Dale Scott &Company, Inc., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, CA94104, phone (415) 956-1030 or by facsimile at (415) 956-1322, and the sale will be awarded by the Superintendent of the Palm Springs Unified School District, or his designee, on behalf of the Board of Education of the Palm Springs Unified School District within twenty-six (26) hours after the bid opening is completed. In the event that the Superintendent,or his authorized designee, does not award a bid on the date specified above, proposals will be received the following Thursday at the same time and place specified above, and each Thursday thereafter, until such time as a bid is awarded or notice to the contrary is given. Further

information, including copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor at the above address. BOND COUNSEL: Bowie, Arneson, Kadi, Wiles &Giannone, Newport Beach, California. DATED: June 23, 1997
